summary_1line: Rama instructs Shatrughna on defeating Lavana by attacking before he retrieves Shiva’s weapon, then equips him with troops, wealth, and supplies for the mission.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama addresses Shatrughna in the royal court while attendants stand beside rows of horses, chariots, and elephants prepared for the campaign.
Lavana the demon roams the wilderness hunting while his terrible divine weapon rests honored inside his dwelling.
Shatrughna stands armed with a drawn bow at the entrance of the Madhu forest, waiting to challenge Lavana before the demon reaches his weapon.
